data.name: Ainool
data.gender_notes: Ainool is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ain (unique, precious) +ool (one). The name Ainool carries the meaning “Unique, precious one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Ainool usually hope their child will grow to embody unique, precious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ainool belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Unique, precious one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ainool total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عينول
in_arabic.meaning: عينول تعني العين التي تنبثق منها الحقيقة و الاطلاع
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عينول مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عين' و 'نول'، و يعني العين التي تنبثق منها الحقيقة و الاطلاع. و في القرآن الكريم، العين هي رمز للبصيرة و الفهم. يعتبر اسم عينول ذا أهمية روحية كبيرة في التقاليد الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالعين الداخلية التي ترى الحقيقة.

in_urdu.name: عینول
in_urdu.meaning: عینول کا مطلب ہے وہ عین جو حقیقت و معرفت کا منبع ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عینول نام عربی جڑ 'عین' و 'نول' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ عین جو حقیقت و معرفت کا منبع ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، عینول نام کی روحانی اہمیت ہے، جو اندرونی بصیرت اور حقیقت کے ادراک کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام علم و حکمت کی جستجو کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ऐनूल
in_hindi.meaning: ऐनूल का अर्थ है सच्चाई और ज्ञान का स्रोत आँख
in_hindi.long_meaning: ऐनूल नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية जड़ों 'عين' और 'نول' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सच्चाई और ज्ञान का स्रोत आँख। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, ऐनूल नाम का आध्यात्मिक महत्व है, जो आंतरिक दृष्टि और सच्चाई की समझ का प्रतीक है। यह नाम ज्ञान और बुद्धि की खोज को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عينول
in_pashto.meaning: عينول د معنی دا لری هغه سترګه چې حقیقت پکې څرګندیږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: عينول نوم د عربي ريښو 'عين' او 'نول' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې هغه سترګه چې حقیقت پکې څرګندیږي. په پښتنو او افغانانو کې، دا نوم روحاني ارزښت لري، د باطني ليدنې او حقیقت د پوهاوي نښه ده. دا نوم د پوهې او حکمت د لټون څرګندنه کوي.

in_english.name: Ainool
in_english.meaning: Ainool means the eye from which truth and knowledge emanate
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ainool is derived from the Arabic roots 'ayn' and 'nwl', signifying the eye from which truth and knowledge emanate. In Islamic tradition, Ainool holds spiritual significance, symbolizing inner sight and perception of reality. The name is associated with qualities of insight, wisdom, and enlightenment, reflecting the pursuit of knowledge and truth across Muslim cultures.

It represents the belief in the unique and precious nature of every individual, emphasizing the intrinsic worth and value of each being. Moreover, the letter 'l' in "ool" signifies the continuity and oneness of Allah in our lives, underlining the concept of unity and connection among people in this world and beyond.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Ainool is often associated with the idea of being one with Allah (God). Ain (unique, precious) represents the individual's yearning to be in the presence of the Almighty and yearning to attain devotion and sincerity. The letter 'l' in "ool" is a constant reminder of the belief that God is the only, eternal, and self-sufficient source. Thus, the name Ainool signifies the spiritual journey of an individual to unite with Allah and embrace the divine essence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name "Ainool" in Arabic means "the two eyes." In the spiritual context, it could be seen as a reminder to keep our inner and outer eyes focused on the path of righteousness, seeking knowledge and truth with unwavering vision.
